# API schemas

## workflowbody



- `name` — string. The name of the workflow Example: `"Send Email"`
- `owner` — object. The identity that owns the workflow. The owner's permissions in IDN will determine what actions the workflow is allowed to perform. Ownership can be changed by updating the owner in a PUT or PATCH request.
- `description` — string. Description of what the workflow accomplishes Example: `"Send an email to the identity who's attributes changed."`
- `definition` — workflowdefinition. The map of steps that the workflow will execute.
- `enabled` — boolean. Enable or disable the workflow. Workflows cannot be created in an enabled state. Example: `false`
- `trigger` — workflowtrigger. The trigger that starts the workflow

## workflowtrigger

The trigger that starts the workflow

- `type` (required) — string. The trigger type One of: EVENT, EXTERNAL, SCHEDULED, . Example: `"EVENT"`
- `displayName` — string. The trigger display name
- `mode` — string. Mode used by the trigger. One of: basic, advanced. Example: `"advanced"`
- `attributes` (required) — object. Workflow Trigger Attributes.

## eventattributes

Attributes related to an IdentityNow ETS event

- `id` (required) — string. The unique ID of the trigger Example: `"idn:identity-attributes-changed"`
- `filter.$` — string. JSON path expression that will limit which events the trigger will fire on. When the trigger's `mode` is `basic`, this must match the expression compiled from `filterDefinition`. Example: `"$.changes[?(@.attribute == \"manager\")]"`
- `filterDefinition` — object. Basic-mode filter that `filter.$` is compiled from. Required when the trigger's `mode` is `basic`, and must be omitted otherwise.
- `description` — string. Description of the event trigger Example: `"Triggered when an identity's manager attribute changes"`
- `attributeToFilter` — string. For the `sp:form-submitted` trigger, the name of the form element to filter on. Use it with `operatorValue` and `attributeValue`. For other event triggers this is a legacy field from the earlier trigger filter picker; use `filterDefinition` with `mode` set… Example: `"department"`
- `operatorValue` — string. For the `sp:form-submitted` trigger, the operator that compares the `attributeToFilter` form element with `attributeValue`, such as `StringEquals`, `StringContains`, `StringStartsWith`, `NumericGreaterThan`, `BooleanEquals` or `ArrayAnyOf`. Create and update… Example: `"StringEquals"`
- `attributeValue` — string. For the `sp:form-submitted` trigger, the value the `attributeToFilter` form element is compared with. For `ArrayAnyOf`, use a list such as `['HR', 'IT']`. Create and update requests that set this field for the `idn:identity-created` trigger are rejected. Example: `"IT"`
- `formDefinitionId` — string. For the `sp:form-submitted` trigger, the ID of the form whose submission starts the workflow. Required when `filter.$` is not set. When `filter.$` is not set, the trigger filter is built from this ID, narrowed by `attributeToFilter`, `operatorValue` and… Example: `"49841cb8-00a5-4fbd-9888-8bbb28d48331"`

## scheduledattributes

Attributes related to a scheduled trigger

- `frequency` (required) — string. Frequency of execution One of: daily, weekly, monthly, yearly, cronSchedule. Example: `"daily"`
- `timeZone` — string. Time zone identifier Example: `"America/Chicago"`
- `cronString` — string. A valid CRON expression Example: `"0 9 * * 1"`
- `weeklyDays` — array of string. Scheduled days of the week for execution Example: `"Monday"`
- `weeklyTimes` — array of string. Scheduled execution times Example: `"Monday"`
- `yearlyTimes` — array of string. Scheduled execution times Example: `"1969-12-31T09:00:00.000Z"`

## externalattributes

Attributes related to an external trigger

- `name` — string. A unique name for the external trigger Example: `"search-and-notify"`
- `description` — string. Additional context about the external trigger Example: `"Run a search and notify the results"`
- `clientId` — string. OAuth Client ID to authenticate with this trigger Example: `"87e239b2-b85b-4bde-b9a7-55bf304ddcdc"`
- `url` — string. URL to invoke this workflow Example: `"https://example-tenant.api.identitynow.com/workflows/v1/execute/external/c79e0079-562c-4df5-aa73-60a9e25c916d"`

## workflowdefinition

The map of steps that the workflow will execute.

- `start` — string. The name of the starting step. Example: `"Send Email Test"`
- `steps` — object. One or more step objects that comprise this workflow. Please see the Workflow documentation to see the JSON schema for each step type. Example: `{"Send Email": {"actionId": "sp:send-email", "attributes": {"body": "This is a test", "from": "sailpoint@sailpoint.com", "recipientId.$": "$.identity.id", "subj`

## workflowexecution



- `id` — string. Workflow execution ID. Example: `"b393f4e2-4785-4d7f-ab27-3a6b8ded4c81"`
- `workflowId` — string. Workflow ID. Example: `"d201c5d9-d37b-4a2f-af14-66414f39d568"`
- `requestId` — string. Backend ID that tracks a workflow request in the system. Provide this ID in a customer support ticket for debugging purposes. Example: `"41e12a74fa7b4a6a98ae47887b64acdb"`
- `startTime` — string. Date/time when the workflow started. Example: `"2022-02-07T20:13:29.356648026Z"`
- `closeTime` — string. Date/time when the workflow ended. Example: `"2022-02-07T20:13:31.682410165Z"`
- `status` — string. Workflow execution status. One of: Completed, Failed, Canceled, Running, Queued. Example: `"Completed"`
